title: Walk to Broadway! 2BR/2BA Modern Condo + Parking
description:
Save $50+ a night on ride-shares by walking to Broadway's famous honky tonks in 15 minutes. This modern 2BR/2BA condo is built for easy group getaways.

Why Guests Love Staying Here:
• Prime Location: 1 mile to Broadway & Country
Music Hall of Fame.
• No Bathroom Bottlenecks: 2 full baths with double vanities
• Group-Friendly Layout: 2 Queen beds & twin bunks
• Owner-Operated: Cleaned and cared for directly by a Superhost—no generic property management companies.

The space
** Bedroom 1
Queen Bed
Outside Balcony
Smart TV
En Suite Bathroom with Shower and Double Vanity Sinks

** Bedroom 2
Queen Bed
Smart TV
En Suite Bathroom with access to common area (Jack and Jill Bathroom)
Shower/Tub Combo and Double Vanity Sinks

** Common Area
Twin Bunk Beds that sleeps 2

*** Premium sheets, pillows, and mattresses for all beds
*** Towels, shampoo, body wash, and make-up towels provided

CLOSE AND CONVENIENT WALK TO:

» Bars on Broadway: 0.9 miles
» Bridgestone Arena: 1.1 miles
» Music City Center: 0.9 miles
» Nissan Stadium: 1.3 miles

NO LOCAL BOOKINGS - Inquiry Only - Select the "Contact Host" Button so we can discuss

FREE STREET PARKING - There is free street parking in front of the building 

SELF PAY PARKING GARAGE - The attached parking garage is not included in your booking. There is a 50% Off Discount QR code that you can scan in the Lobby, Elevator, and inside the info folder in the condo. The current rate is $25/day when you scan the Discount QR Code.  

PLEASE NOTE: 
PARTIES ARE NOT ALLOWED (Bachelorette and Bachelor groups ARE allowed). NO SMOKING ALLOWED

Guest access
Guest will be given a personalized code 24 hours before check in via email

Parking Garage - This is a Self Pay parking garage that is Not Included in your booking. There is a Discount QR Code in the Lobby, Elevator, and inside the info folder in the condo. By scanning the Discount QR Code you will receive 50% Off your parking.

Other things to note
Have a question? Select the "Contact Host" button and I'd be happy to answer any questions or booking requests you may have!
